approved_by: Jason 2026-10-26 (prefreeze defaults; session-audit decisions; plan approval)
execution_gates: development replay (2019-05-01..2024-12-31 partition) requires Jason's explicit authorization
locked held-out read (2025-01-01..2026-10-21) requires separate explicit authorization and happens once

source.paper: Fetna (2026), Opening-Range Breakout Does Not Survive Trading Costs, unreviewed preprint
sourced_rules: one-minute N-bar opening range with void range on any missing minute
first post-range minute close outside range, next minute open entry
one trade per side, no re-entry after stop, no same-bar double breakout
R2 stop 10% of prior 14-day ATR, no target, flat at close
gap-through stop fill at bar open
source.paper_result: headline negative after costs; adaptation is a falsification/replication, not a demonstrated edge

instrument.comparison_rule: MES reported separately under the identical rule; cannot rescue an MNQ miss
instrument.primary_roll: D-ROLL-01: from the CME trade date equal to the contract's expiration minus eight calendar days (holiday-adjusted), trade the next quarterly; versioned in contract_map

sessions.eligible_calendar: NYSE cash-open sessions (08:30 CT open exists); CME-only holiday sessions are never candidate days
sessions.calendar_source: pandas_market_calendars 5.5.0 NYSE + CME_Equity; CME equity early close fixed at 12:15 CT (overrides library 12:00; bar data and CME 2011 notice)
sessions.bar_timestamp: ts_event labels minute start; a bar is known at minute end
sessions.trade_date: CME Globex trade date; bars at or after 17:00 CT belong to the next trade date

rule.void_range_day: eligible no-trade day: ORB $0 and control $0
rule.signal: first completed one-minute bar (start >= 08:45 CT) closing strictly above range high (long) or strictly below range low (short)
rule.entry: open of the minute immediately after the signal bar; if that bar is absent, skip that signal and log it; never fill a missing minute or chase the next visible open
rule.new_entry_cutoff_local_time_inclusive: 14:30 (entry fill minute), or exit minute minus 1 on early-close days if earlier
rule.opposite_direction_after_exit: allowed if flat and direction unused; its signal bar must start after the exit bar (no signal on the exit bar itself)
rule.simultaneous_double_break: impossible for one close with range high >= low; assert invariant

atr.session_set: the 14 NYSE cash sessions immediately before the candidate day; CME-only holiday sessions skipped
atr.contract_history: dated contract being traded on the candidate day; no stitching
atr.true_range: max(H - L, |H - C_prev|, |L - C_prev|) per prior session
atr.high_low: max high / min low over all bars of the dated contract in that session's CME trade date (17:00 CT previous day to 16:00 CT)
atr.prior_close_session_definition: close of the last one-minute bar of the dated contract starting before that session's CME equity close (15:00 CT normal; 12:15 CT early close); C_prev is that close for the preceding NYSE session in the set
atr.required_sessions: 15 sessions with a regular-hours close (14 true ranges plus the close before the first); any missing -> candidate day ineligible, decided from data only
atr.aggregation: simple mean of the 14 true ranges
atr.distance_rounding: 0.10 x ATR rounded to the nearest 0.25-point tick, exact half tick rounds up (ROUND_HALF_UP), minimum one tick

rule.stop: long: entry price minus rounded distance; short: entry plus rounded distance. Filled at the stop level, or at the bar open if the bar opens through it. On the entry bar, a touch counts as stopped (adverse first). No target.
rule.early_close_flatten: open of the minute 3 minutes before the 12:15 CT close (12:12 CT)
rule.missing_minute_with_live_stop: unknown execution. Stress bound = worse of stop level and next visible bar's adverse extreme; reported only as a bound, never as an observed fill. No later visible bar before flatten -> non-evaluable trade
rule.missing_flatten_bar_with_live_position: non-evaluable; never a fabricated fill and never counted as a $0 day
rule.missing_minute_alarm: if >1% of eligible sessions OR >1% of executed trades have a missing minute while a stop is live, the affected result is inconclusive; below that, any verdict that flips under the stress bound is also inconclusive

costs.accounting: subtract L3 exactly once per completed round trip from reference-price P&L; no extra spread or stop slippage; gap-through OHLC reference stays adverse
costs.stress: L1-L4 fixed, L5 delayed/no-fill; reported, nonselectable

data_partitions.missing_session_eligibility: candidate day = eligible-calendar session with ATR history complete (rule.atr.required_sessions). Void range -> eligible $0 day. No bars in the cash window -> ineligible (data only). Non-evaluable trades are counted and reported separately and never imputed

controls.seed_scheme: numpy PCG64 seeded with [draw_seed, root_code (MNQ=1, MES=2), yyyymmdd of trade date]; draws generated in order 0..499
controls.legal_entry_minutes: fill minutes 08:46..entry cutoff inclusive (rule.new_entry_cutoff_local_time_inclusive), strictly after any previous control trade's exit minute
controls.legal_minute_endpoint_and_invalid_draw_p: draw a fill minute uniformly among legal minutes; if that bar is absent, redraw from the same generator (deterministic rejection, count logged); if no legal minute with a bar remains, that control trade is not taken and is logged
controls.direction: uniform long/short per control trade, independent of the ORB direction
controls.trade_count_matching_policy: each draw takes k sequential trades, k = the ORB's executed entry count that day (0, 1 or 2); k = 0 -> control $0
controls.same_as_orb: dated contract, ATR stop distance, stop/gap fill rules, flatten minute, L3 cost, missing-minute policy
controls.control_daily_aggregation: control daily P&L = arithmetic mean of the 500 draws' net daily P&L

inference.estimand: MNQ net USD per eligible day at L3, including $0 for no-trade days
inference.primary_statistic: mean over eligible days of (ORB net USD minus control daily P&L)
inference.null_and_test_algorithm: one-sided; stationary bootstrap (Politis-Romano) of complete paired eligible days with mean block length 5; resample the null-centred paired differences (d - mean d); p = (1 + #{bootstrap mean >= observed mean}) / (B + 1)
inference.block_length_sensitivity: Politis-White (2004) automatic block length with Patton-Politis-White (2009) correction; reported only, cannot change the verdict
inference.decision: pass requires p < 0.05 AND observed mean absolute MNQ net >= $15 per eligible day; the lower-one-sided-CI > $15 alternative is rejected
inference.power_target: 80% at true +$20/day absolute and at +$20/day paired advantage
inference.development_only_power_mde: computed from the authorized development replay (empirical variance and dependence) before any held-out read. If power < 80%, either extend with prospective data or record inconclusive; the $15 floor is never lowered

selection.effective_trial_count_or_range: decisive test is the locked 2025-2026 period, unseen by anyone; DSR reported at N=1 and N=25
selection.dsr_treatment: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) DSR on the ORB daily net series at N=1 and N=25, cross-trial Sharpe variance proxied by the variance of the 500 control draws' daily Sharpe ratios; diagnostic only, not a gate

ambiguity.denominator_and_zero_trade_policy: denominator = executed ORB trades in the development replay; zero trades -> not_estimable
ambiguity.response: review before any held-out read; no tuning on held-out

development_only_prop_eval.scope: outside this freeze; requires a frozen-rule development replay and a selected venue/rulebook; never a strategy gate or purchase authorization

provenance.spec_hash: sha256 of this file's bytes, recorded in sc-fut-0001-spec.v1.sha256 and the trial ledger
